projects.title: Envoy Builder (CreatorsAGI)
projects.description:
Enterprise platform for building AI companions trained on your own knowledge. 
 
 My current project. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, and Typescript. I work across the companion editor, RAG knowledge management, file upload flows, and versioned publishing in a multi-tenant app with WorkOS authentication.

projects.title: Conscious
projects.description:
Chrome extension for mindful shopping. 
 
 A gentle prompt appears while you shop on Amazon, asking whether the purchase is really necessary, and a private dashboard tracks what you saved by walking away. Shopping data never leaves the browser. Landing page built with Next.js.

projects.title: FormKiQ
projects.description:
Document Management Platform. 
 
 Utilized React, Typescript, Redux, Tailwind, and other technologies to implement new functionalities, such as enabling the creation of archives and displaying user activities. Engineered an intuitive front-end interface for interactive drag-and-drop workflows utilizing the React Flow library.

projects.title: Royal Path
projects.description:
React Native game with tinder-swipe mechanics. 
 
 As a monarch, navigate advisors, villagers, allies, and foes! Choose to battle or befriend mystical creatures. Strengthen your army or pursue diplomacy. Shape your kingdom's destiny!
